revenue_model: Kamino takes 0.1% fee on borrows and 10% performance fee on leveraged strategies. Estimated monthly revenue: $2.5M (based on 1.25B TVL, 5% average utilization, 10% APY spread).
automation_details: Fully automatable via Kamino API (kamino.finance/api/v1) and Solana RPC. Agents can monitor TVL, borrow rates, and execute strategies autonomously using MCP tools.
